notes: Six playbooks, one per kind of job a WCM author actually gets. Each one carries only what that job needs and the literal steps to do it in each CMS. Signal weights: 4 = structural giveaway, 3 = strong, 2 = medium, 1 = weak. Every brief is scored against every playbook; highest total wins.

cms.note: The estate is mid-migration and most of it is still Tridion, so AEM is the exception: only the markets listed in aemMarkets have moved. Add a market here when it migrates. A .aspx page is Tridion whatever market it sits on. All assets live in Adobe DAM now whichever CMS serves the site, so DAM links never decide the platform — only the target site URL does.

compare.note: Which element wraps the main content decides whether the body report is signal or nav labels. These are the standard fallbacks; if a KONE template uses its own wrapper, add its class here (leading dot) ahead of the fallbacks. Redirect and removal are absent on purpose: they are verified by following the URL, not by reading markup. assetVariantPattern strips crop and size suffixes so a DAM variant still resolves to the source asset; widen it if a template uses other suffixes.

workTypes.label: Redirect
workTypes.summary: Point one or more old URLs at a new destination.

needs.label: Source URL(s)
needs.question: Which URL(s) are being redirected? Give the full path for each one.

needs.label: Destination URL(s)
needs.question: Where should each source URL land? Give the full destination URL.

AEM: Open AEM Author → Tools → ACS Commons → Redirect Manager.
Select the redirect configuration for this site.
Add one row per pair: Source = the old path, Target = the destination URL, Status = 301.
Save the configuration.
Publish the redirect configuration.
Open a source URL in a private window and confirm it lands on the destination.
Tridion: Find the site folder in Tridion for that domain.
Check which redirect mechanism this site uses, then follow either A or B below.
A — Redirect component: open Building Blocks → the Redirection folder → create a new redirect component holding the source and destination → save.
A — Publish the redirect root page under root/system/redirects.
B — Page metadata: find the source page from the URL structure, or open it by TCM ID → open the page → fill the redirect fields in its metadata → save.
B — Publish the page.
Open a source URL in a private window and confirm it lands on the destination.

workTypes.label: Page removal
workTypes.summary: Take a page off the live site because something supersedes it, and send its URL to the replacement.

needs.label: Page(s) to remove
needs.question: Which page(s) are being taken down? Give the full URL for each one.

needs.label: Replacement URL to redirect to
needs.question: Which URL supersedes these — where should the old URLs land once the pages are down?

AEM: Open AEM Sites and navigate to the page.
Unpublish the page: Manage Publication → Unpublish. Leave the page in AEM — removal here means taking it off the live site, not deleting it.
Open Tools → ACS Commons → Redirect Manager and add the redirect: Source = the old path, Target = the replacement URL, Status = 301.
Publish the redirect configuration.
Open the old URL in a private window and confirm it lands on the replacement rather than a 404.
Repeat for every market listed in the brief — each country site is its own page and its own redirect.
Tridion: Find the site folder, then the page from its URL structure (or open it by TCM ID).
Unpublish the page from the live site. Leave it in Tridion — removal here means taking it off the live site, not deleting it.
Set up the redirect to the replacement, using whichever mechanism this site uses: Building Blocks → the Redirection folder → a new redirect component, or the old page's metadata.
Publish the redirect — the redirect root page under root/system/redirects, or the page itself if the redirect sits in its metadata.
Open the old URL in a private window and confirm it lands on the replacement rather than a 404.
Repeat for every market listed in the brief — each country site is its own page and its own redirect.

workTypes.label: Content update
workTypes.summary: Change something on a page that already exists — copy, image, link, or a component added, removed or moved.

needs.label: Target page URL
needs.question: Which page is being changed? Give the full URL.

needs.label: What to change
needs.question: What exactly should change on that page — and what should it become?

AEM: Open AEM Sites and navigate to the page.
Find the component holding the content named in the brief.
Make the change exactly as the brief states.

Image change — open the asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot (hero, card, banner), adjust the crop if needed, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component's image URL field.
Link change — set internal links with the Path Picker; paste external URLs in full.
Preview the page.
Publish, then check the live URL in a private window.
Tridion: Find the site folder, then the page from its URL structure (or open it by TCM ID).
Open the component holding the content named in the brief.
Make the change exactly as the brief states.
Image change — open the asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot, adjust the crop if needed, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component's image URL field.
Save the component.
Publish the page, then check the live URL in a private window.

workTypes.label: New page
workTypes.summary: Build a page that does not exist yet, from a brief that carries all of its content.

needs.label: URL path
needs.question: What is the full URL path for the new page?

needs.label: Meta title
needs.question: What should the meta title be?

needs.label: Meta description
needs.question: What should the meta description be?

needs.label: Section content
needs.question: What content goes in each section of the page, in order?

AEM: In AEM Sites, open the parent folder for that path and create the page from the right template. Set the page name to the last segment of the URL path.
Open Page Properties and set the meta title, meta description and meta keywords from the brief.
Work down the brief section by section, adding the component each section calls for and filling in its heading and body.
Images — open the named asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component.
Links — set internal links with the Path Picker; paste external URLs in full.
Add the FAQ or accordion component for any Q&A block at the end of the brief.
Preview the page, then publish.
Tridion: Find the site folder and the parent structure group matching the URL path.
Create the page from the right page template.
Create the components the brief calls for in Building Blocks and add them to the page in the brief's order.
Fill in the page metadata: meta title, meta description, meta keywords.
Images — open the named asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component.
Save the page, then publish it.

workTypes.label: Keyword update
workTypes.summary: Set the primary keyword on each page in a keyword mapping sheet. The keyword only — not the title, description or copy.

needs.label: Page(s) to update
needs.question: Which pages does this cover? Give the full URL for each row.

needs.label: Primary keyword per page
needs.question: Which keyword should each page target?

AEM: Open AEM Sites and navigate to the page.
Open Page Properties and set the keyword field to the primary keyword given for that row.
Leave the meta title, meta description and body copy exactly as they are — this job is the keyword only.
Save, then publish the page.
Check the published page's metadata carries the keyword.
Repeat for every row in the sheet, working down in priority order.
Tridion: Find the site folder, then the page from its URL structure (or open it by TCM ID).
Open the page's metadata and set the keyword field to the primary keyword given for that row.
Leave the meta title, meta description and body copy exactly as they are — this job is the keyword only.
Save, then publish the page.
Check the published page's metadata carries the keyword.
Repeat for every row in the sheet, working down in priority order.

workTypes.label: Localization
workTypes.summary: Put a market's own language onto a page whose English master already exists.

needs.label: Target market site
needs.question: Which market site is this for — which country domain should it be published to?

needs.label: Page path
needs.question: Which page on that market site is being localized? Give the path.

needs.label: Localized content
needs.question: Where is the translated copy? Each field needs its local-language text.

AEM: Open the market's page in AEM Sites — it already carries the English master content rolled out from the master.
Go component by component in the brief's order, replacing the English text with the local-language text from the brief.
Update each component's config as the brief states: CTA labels, link paths, anchor targets, spec table values.
Images — open the asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component.
Preview the page and check nothing is left in English.
Publish, then check the live URL in a private window.
Tridion: Find the market's site folder — the English master content is already there, ready to localize.
Open each component in the brief's order and replace the English text with the local-language text from the brief.
Update each component's config as the brief states: CTA labels, link paths, anchor targets, spec table values.
Images — open the asset in Adobe DAM, choose Smart Crop, pick the preset for the slot, copy the embed URL, and paste it into the component.
Save the components and check nothing is left in English.
Publish the page, then check the live URL in a private window.
